description_en: API operation for the product image tampering detection service. Detects image tampering, quality (clarity), and similar images
description_zh: 商品图片篡改检测服务的API接口。接口可检测图片篡改、质量（清晰度）及相似图
kebab_example: aliyun cloudauth credential-product-verify-v2 --cred-type 05 --cred-name 0501 --image-url https://aliyundoc.com/picture00000.jpeg --image-file https://aliyundoc.com/picture00000.jpeg --merchant-id '无。' --product-code ANTI_FAKE_CHECK --api-version 2019-03-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CredentialProductVerifyV2

parameters.help_en: The credential type. Only the following value is supported: 05 (product image)
parameters.help_zh: 凭证类型：仅支持取值：05 （商品图片）
parameters.name: cred_type

parameters.help_en: The credential name. Only the following value is supported: 0501 (product image)
parameters.help_zh: 凭证名称：仅支持取值：0501（商品图片）
parameters.name: cred_name

parameters.help_en: The InputStream object of the image
parameters.name: image_file

parameters.help_en: The call mode. Only the following value is supported: ANTI_FAKE_CHECK
parameters.help_zh:
调用模式：
仅支持取值：ANTI_FAKE_CHECK
parameters.name: product_code
